content: README.md states Zenless Zone Zero Ver.3.1 (first case, Remiel) is scheduled to launch on 2026-07-29 (JST), that pre-launch status is fixed at AWAITING_POSTLAUNCH_OBSERVATION, that the system will not fabricate rankings, engagement or revenue that have not yet happened, and that after launch only T_release, T+24h and T+72h Japan mobile public rankings and official content interactions will be recorded as weak external validation rather than claims of verified real-world treatment effects.
notes: README.md section 日本发行实验室. event_time is the scheduled launch date as claimed by the document: date-only, JST timezone per source, not externally verified. The pre-launch framing is the document's own statement; because the document's publication time is not established, time_usage stays unclassified.

content: README.md boundary statements: synthetic agents do not replace real player research; current outputs are directional experiment results, not predictions of Japan all-platform, Tokyo-region or single-character real revenue; public mobile rankings and engagement counts are weak proxies that cannot yield precise revenue or real-world causal effects; P1 adds no real game accounts, real pulls or payments.
notes: README.md sections 日本发行实验室 and 边界. Defines the scope limits mirrored in gaps.csv G02-G05.
